| 03 | Pooling & Receptive Fields | 🟢 Beginner | 🛠️ in progress | Pooling operations and receptive field concepts. |
| 04 | Architecting CNNs in PyTorch | 🟡 Intermediate | 🛠️ in progress | Building CNNs and best practices in PyTorch. |
| 05 | Enterprise Backbones | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | Backbone architectures and pretrained models. |
| 06 | Transfer Learning & Fine-Tuning | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | Fine-tuning strategies and transfer learning workflows. |
| 07 | Vision Data Pipelines | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | Augmentation, dataset versioning, and loaders. |
| 08 | Object Detection I: Metrics | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | Detection metrics, IoU, and evaluation. |
| 09 | Object Detection II: Architectures | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | One-stage vs two-stage detectors and modern models. |
